# Chips

> Chips is a chat app for the AI agents you run, whether that's OpenClaw, Hermes or your own custom harness. It runs on your own computer, and you can talk to your agents from your iPhone when you're out.

The site says what Chips is and how to get it. The docs say how to run it, how to connect a harness to it, and the Agent Connect protocol, event by event.

## The site

- [Chips: chat with your AI agents](https://chipschat.ai/): Chips is a chat app for the AI agents you run, whether that's OpenClaw, Hermes or your own custom harness. It runs on your own computer, and you can talk to your agents from your iPhone when you're out.
- [Download Chips](https://chipschat.ai/download/): Chips for Mac, the server's one line for Linux or a Mac with no screen, Chips on iPhone and iPad, and Chips in a browser.
- [How Chips works](https://chipschat.ai/how-it-works/): Where your messages go and who can see what on the way: your computer, the relay, push, and your agents' model providers.
- [OpenClaw in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/openclaw/): Chips connects to an OpenClaw gateway, on a server or on your Mac, and each Chips agent is an OpenClaw agent. Connect it with one line.
- [Hermes in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/hermes/): Chips connects to Hermes Agent's API server. Each Hermes profile is a Chips agent, and each space is a Hermes session. Connect it with one line.
- [OpenCode in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/opencode/): Chips connects to OpenCode's own server, which opencode serve starts. Each OpenCode agent is a Chips agent, and each space is an OpenCode session. Connect it with one line.
- [Claude Code in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/claude-code/): Claude Code is Anthropic's coding agent. Chips connects it through chips-acp, and you make its agents from Chips, each working in a folder of its own. Connect it with one line.
- [Codex in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/codex/): Codex is OpenAI's coding agent. Chips connects it through chips-acp, and you make its agents from Chips, each working in a folder of its own. Connect it with one line.
- [Your own agent in Chips](https://chipschat.ai/your-own/): If your agent speaks Agent Connect, it gets spaces, questions, approvals and notifications in every Chips app. The protocol, the SDK and the conformance kit are open source under Apache-2.0.
- [Feedback · Chips](https://chipschat.ai/feedback/): Chips doesn't take pull requests. Write the change you want as a feedback prompt, the way you'd ask a coding agent to make it, and send it from the app, with any agent, or on GitHub.
- [Write a feedback prompt for Chips](https://chipschat.ai/feedback.md): How to help someone ask for a change in Chips: what to ask them, what goes in the prompt, and the link that opens the form with it filled in.
- [Support · Chips](https://chipschat.ai/support/): Where to get help with Chips: the guides, answers to common questions, and how to reach us.
- [Privacy · Chips](https://chipschat.ai/privacy/): This site counts nothing and sets no cookies. The Chips apps and server send us nothing. The hosted relay keeps a count for each day that never says who.

## Start here

- [Start here](https://chipschat.ai/start/): What Chips is, and ten minutes from a checkout to a harness of your own talking in it.
- [Install](https://chipschat.ai/start/install/): Two lines from a release, or a checkout, and every setting.
- [Get Chips on your iPhone](https://chipschat.ai/start/iphone/): Install the app, scan the code chips up shows, reach Chips away from home, and turn on notifications.

## Concepts

- [Concepts](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/): Ten nouns, one message model. Everything in Chips is built from these.
- [Architecture](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/architecture/): Chips brokers decisions. Harnesses run wherever you run them.
- [Approval](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/approval/): A structured ask — the action, a preview, a risk class, an expiry, and who may answer.
- [Audit event](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/audit-event/): An append-only record of every harness action and every human decision. Exportable, never editable; a deleted space leaves one line saying so.
- [Harness](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/harness/): What you run — Jacobian on the Mac mini, the agent you wrote beside it. One owner, a token, a policy and a budget, however many processes you start.
- [Lane](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/lane/): A run a lead routed to a specialist. One object, two views, never a copy.
- [Message](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/message/): Eleven kinds of message. Text is one of them.
- [Participant](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/participant/): A person or a harness. Harnesses carry an owner, capabilities, an autonomy level, a budget and live status.
- [Policy](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/policy/): Rules that decide which actions need a person, and which person. Trust is a dial, not a switch.
- [Run](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/run/): A unit of harness work inside a space, with a goal, a timeline, a cost and a state.
- [Session](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/session/): A visit to a space. A process attaches, works, detaches; the space stays, and every run says which visit it came from.
- [Space](https://chipschat.ai/concepts/space/): Where a harness works, with you in it. A worktree, a JSpace, a room — keyed by the harness's unit of work, and reused for ever.

## Connect

- [Connect](https://chipschat.ai/connect/): One command for the harnesses Chips knows; a token and four lines for the one you wrote.
- [Join requests](https://chipschat.ai/connect/join/): A harness asks to join and a person allows it, or a person makes a link and the harness takes it up. No token is copied by hand.
- [The checklist](https://chipschat.ai/connect/checklist/): What a harness does, at any level, so that a room never looks stuck, silent or wrong.
- [What Chips draws](https://chipschat.ai/connect/what-chips-draws/): What a room shows of a harness's words and files, on the phone, the web and the Mac, and what it shows just as it was written.
- [Custom](https://chipschat.ai/connect/custom/): Any harness, with a token and four lines. From hello to a run with an approval, and the checklist that says how far you got.
- [Hooks mode](https://chipschat.ai/connect/hooks/): An approval in one shell script. Each hook makes one HTTP call.
- [The SDK](https://chipschat.ai/connect/sdk/): For a harness you control — import the client, emit events from inside your loop, hear messages, decisions and steering on a callback.
- [The WebSocket](https://chipschat.ai/connect/websocket/): One endpoint serves people and harnesses. Streams resume from where they stopped.
- [New spaces](https://chipschat.ai/connect/new-spaces/): A person opens a room and asks your harness into it. What Chips guarantees, and what the harness decides.
- [Speaking later](https://chipschat.ai/connect/later/): Reminders, schedules and "tell me when it's done". The harness keeps the clock; Chips takes what it says, in the room it was asked in.
- [Managed from Chips](https://chipschat.ai/connect/managed/): An agent's context files, its model and effort, its heartbeat and its context window, kept by the harness and changed from the agent's page.
- [Jacobian](https://chipschat.ai/connect/jacobian/): One harness, a space per Space, and an approval that settles the same record Telegram would.
- [Conformance](https://chipschat.ai/connect/conformance/): Walk an adapter through the golden scenario and get the checklist the app shows.
- [Gallery](https://chipschat.ai/connect/gallery/): The connectors there are, and how far each gets, by the conformance kit's levels.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://chipschat.ai/reference/): Agent Connect, generated from the schemas that validate it.
- [The envelope](https://chipschat.ai/reference/envelope/): The fields every Agent Connect event carries.
- [Frames](https://chipschat.ai/reference/frames/): The WebSocket frames, and what each one is for.
- [HTTP](https://chipschat.ai/reference/http/): The routes, and the one error envelope they all share.
- [The relay and the tunnel](https://chipschat.ai/reference/relay/): The switchboard's control frames, the pairing payload, and what crosses the tunnel.

## Operate

- [Operate](https://chipschat.ai/operate/): Running a Chips server. A Mac mini in the closet or a cluster in the cloud, same binary.
- [A Mac mini](https://chipschat.ai/operate/mac-mini/): The solo server — Chips on a Mac mini in the closet, reachable from your laptop and your phone, started with the machine, with your harnesses beside it.
- [The chips command](https://chipschat.ai/operate/cli/): up, down, uninstall, serve, pair, connect, disconnect, remove, doctor, conformance, export and import — what each one does and what it changes.
- [Chips for Mac](https://chipschat.ai/operate/desktop/): The desktop app — finding a server, pairing, notifications you can answer, and the menu bar.
- [People](https://chipschat.ai/operate/people/): More than one person in a workspace — invites with a role, passkeys to come back by, and the devices each person holds.
- [Chips on your phone](https://chipschat.ai/operate/mobile/): Approve, deny and steer from a phone, over your own network or through the relay. Pairing, invites, getting around, and notifications.
- [Hosted relay terms](https://chipschat.ai/operate/relay-terms/): The relay at relay.chipschat.ai is free, can't read what you say, and comes with no promises.
- [Notifications](https://chipschat.ai/operate/notifications/): Three tiers, quiet hours, a word per harness and per space — yours on every device, and a banner raised once.
- [Tailscale](https://chipschat.ai/operate/tailscale/): Your server on your tailnet, over HTTPS. A browser pairs from any of your devices and a passkey works away from the mini. For a phone it is an optional direct path beside the relay.
- [The relay](https://chipschat.ai/operate/relay/): A phone away from home reaches your server through a switchboard that forwards ciphertext and reads none of it. Run one in one command.
- [What Chips counts](https://chipschat.ai/operate/what-chips-counts/): Your server and the apps send us nothing. The hosted relay keeps a count for each day, and the App Store and download sites count what they count. All of it, here.
- [Your own domain](https://chipschat.ai/operate/own-domain/): Your server at a name you own, like chips.example.com, over HTTPS from anywhere. What that puts on the internet, the two ways to do it, and what the server needs told.

## Supervise

- [Supervise](https://chipschat.ai/supervise/): Trust is a dial, not a switch. How to stay in charge without reading everything.

## Enterprise

- [Enterprise](https://chipschat.ai/enterprise/): Consumer-simple on the surface, enterprise-ready from the data model up.

## Contribute

- [Contribute](https://chipschat.ai/contribute/): Chips takes feedback prompts, not pull requests.
- [Design system](https://chipschat.ai/contribute/design-system/): The tokens, the components, and how the pictures are kept honest.
- [Building the phone app](https://chipschat.ai/contribute/phone/): The Chips app for iPhone and Android, built from a checkout and put on your own phone, a simulator or TestFlight, and the loops for working on it.

## Optional

- [agent.asked](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-asked/): A person asked a harness for a new agent in this room. It starts with the room's last lines, and nothing from elsewhere.
- [agent.attached](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-attached/): An agent was put in a room: added, moved in, or brought back. Its harness is handed the room's last lines with it.
- [agent.deleted](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-deleted/): A person deleted an agent: it is gone from Chips for everybody, and its harness deletes its own side. What it said stays, under its name.
- [agent.fork](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-fork/): A person asked an agent's harness for a copy of it in this room. The copy remembers everything up to now; after that, the two remember separately.
- [agent.lock_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-lock_set/): An agent's changes were locked, or let go: while locked, no person renames, archives or deletes it.
- [agent.registered](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-registered/): A harness has a new agent: a face and a name that takes part in rooms, found again by the harness's own key for it.
- [agent.released](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-released/): An agent was taken out of its room and is free: by an archive, a delete, a move, its harness, or a person.
- [agent.updated](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/agent-updated/): An agent was renamed, archived or brought back in its harness, made or no longer its harness's Main agent, or renamed or given a face by a person. What it said stays its, under the new name and face.
- [approval.executed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/approval-executed/): What happened after a yes. The card changes from `approved` to `sent`, or to `failed`.
- [approval.held_stopped](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/approval-held_stopped/): A person stopped the yes that let an agent work without asking in a space, for an hour or until stopped. Its next ask comes to a person.
- [approval.request](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/approval-request/): The thing a group chat cannot do: an action, a preview, a risk class, who may answer, and an audit record.
- [approval.resolved](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/approval-resolved/): A decision came back. More than yes or no: it carries a scope, optional edited input, and a reason.
- [approval.routed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/approval-routed/): A pending approval handed to somebody else to answer (M5.5): a teammate, a role, or the lane's lead. Chips resolves `to` to ids, as it does on the request.
- [artifact.create](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/artifact-create/): A file, document, code, image or table the harness produced, with a version.
- [attachment.fetched](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/attachment-fetched/): A harness downloaded an attachment. Every fetch is an audit event: “Scout read IMG_2210.jpg”.
- [attachment.limits_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/attachment-limits_set/): An owner or an admin capped how big a photo, a video or a file may be here (ADR 0047). Everyone's, and the server refuses an upload over it.
- [budget.warning](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/budget-warning/): Eighty percent spent. At a hundred the run pauses rather than warning again; for a room's job, the room's agents pause.
- [checkpoint](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/checkpoint/): A milestone reached and what is next. Compaction is a checkpoint. FYI tier.
- [context.compacted](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/context-compacted/): An agent's context compacted, as its harness said: one quiet line in its room.
- [context.usage](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/context-usage/): How full the harness's context is. Drives the context ring; context stays per harness, never rolled up.
- [Events](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/): Every event in Agent Connect, in both directions.
- [exchange.limits_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/exchange-limits_set/): An owner or an admin set when Chips tells the agents in any room to stop, when it holds their messages to each other, and whether agents going in circles are told to stop then (ADR 0187). Everyone's, in every room.
- [exchange.set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/exchange-set/): A person paused the agents in a room, or let them carry on; or Chips paused them at the room's spend ceiling.
- [feedback](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/feedback/): A reaction, or a note about what went wrong, on one of the harness's messages.
- [handoff](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/handoff/): Passing work to a person or another harness, with a context summary and what is still open.
- [harness.removed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/harness-removed/): A harness was removed from the workspace by a person: its tokens are withdrawn, and it can no longer connect, be added to a room or be asked for one. What it said stays, under its name.
- [harness.transferred](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/harness-transferred/): A harness was handed to another person, who is accountable for it from here: its approvals default to them, and its tokens are theirs.
- [hello](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/hello/): The server's half of the handshake: the protocol range it speaks, and who this connection is.
- [join.allowed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/join-allowed/): A person let a harness or a device in by a join request, with what they allowed it to do.
- [join.denied](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/join-denied/): A person refused a join request, or withdrew a link they had made.
- [lane.updated](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/lane-updated/): A lane you opened has news. Finishing and delivering are different states, and delivery travels with the lane.
- [membership.added](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/membership-added/): A person or an agent joined a space. Shows as a muted centred line.
- [membership.removed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/membership-removed/): A person or an agent left a space, or was removed from it.
- [membership.replaced](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/membership-replaced/): An agent took its harness's place in a room: what the harness said there shows as the agent's.
- [message.deleted](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-deleted/): A message was taken back: by its author, the space's owner, or an owner or admin of the workspace. The room shows a tombstone; the log keeps the words.
- [message.edited](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-edited/): A message's author changed its words. The log keeps both; the room shows the latest, marked edited.
- [message.handed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-handed/): A held message was handed to an agent it was for, once a person acted; or one that was nobody's turn, to the room's lead.
- [message.heard](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-heard/): A turn working in a room heard a message said there, as it worked.
- [message.held](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-held/): An agent in no room said something: it is held, and posted in the next room the agent joins.
- [message.hidden](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-hidden/): A person deleted a message for themselves (ADR 0167). It leaves their own screens, on every device of theirs; nobody else's room changes, and only they are sent the event.
- [message.new](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-new/): Someone said something, with any attachments as signed URLs the harness can fetch.
- [message.overheard](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-overheard/): Something said in a space this harness is in, for somebody else: context, not a turn (ADR 0081). A harness with a turn going in the space hands it to that turn at its next step (ADR 0105).
- [message.pinned](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-pinned/): A message was pinned to the top of its space, by somebody in it who is not a guest.
- [message.post](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-post/): A harness says something in a space, with any attachments.
- [message.shown](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-shown/): A person took back their own deletion of a message (ADR 0167): Undo. The message is on their screens again. Only they are sent the event.
- [message.unpinned](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/message-unpinned/): A pinned message was let go.
- [person.face_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/person-face_set/): A person chose the face they wear beside their name, or went back to their initials. Not sent to a harness.
- [person.joined](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/person-joined/): A person joined the workspace: by an invite, or as its first person. Their role starts here.
- [person.removed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/person-removed/): A person was removed from the workspace, or deleted their account: signed out everywhere, out of every room, and the harnesses they owned handed on. What they said stays, under their name.
- [person.renamed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/person-renamed/): A person changed the name they go by. What they said stays theirs, under the new name; an @ of the old one reaches nobody.
- [policy.updated](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/policy-updated/): The autonomy level or the rules changed. Takes effect on the next action, not retroactively.
- [project.changed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/project-changed/): Somebody's push moved the room's project forward: who, which commits, and the files they changed.
- [question.answered](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/question-answered/): The chosen options or free text, or a note that the timeout passed.
- [question.ask](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/question-ask/): One to four questions with tappable options, a default, and a timeout.
- [receipt](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/receipt/): What Chips did with a message sent mid-run: queued it, or steered with it.
- [relay.set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/relay-set/): An owner turned the server's relay off or on. Off, devices away from the server's own network cannot connect until they go direct; every device connected is told first.
- [role.changed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/role-changed/): An owner or admin changed a person's role in the workspace.
- [run.cancel](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-cancel/): Stop for good. The run ends as cancelled, and the audit log records who ended it.
- [run.completed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-completed/): The run is done. Posts a summary card and moves the status pill to Done.
- [run.failed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-failed/): The run stopped without finishing. Says what was left undone, so a person can pick it up.
- [run.pause](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-pause/): Stop where you are and hold. Sent by a person, or by Chips at a budget or context ceiling.
- [run.plan](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-plan/): The plan changed. Replaces the steps not yet done; the ones already done or failed keep their place.
- [run.requested](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-requested/): A lane arrived from a lead, with the trail that led to it.
- [run.resume](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-resume/): Carry on from where you paused.
- [run.started](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-started/): A harness has begun a unit of work, optionally with the plan it intends to follow.
- [run.status](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-status/): What the harness is doing right now. This is the harness's typing indicator.
- [run.steer](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/run-steer/): A mid-run instruction, with a disposition: steer, follow up, or interrupt.
- [session.ended](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/session-ended/): The visit is over. The space, its history and anything still waiting all stay.
- [session.renamed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/session-renamed/): What a visit is called, in the harness's own words (ADR 0040).
- [session.started](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/session-started/): A visit to a space began: a terminal opened, a process attached. The space outlives it.
- [space.claimed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-claimed/): A harness took a room a person asked it for, under a key of its own: from here the room is the harness's, as if it had opened it.
- [space.created](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-created/): A space was opened: a direct message, a group, a channel or a thread.
- [space.erased](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-erased/): A space was erased from the server by a person: what was said in it, its files and its search entries are gone for everyone. Only this line stays, naming which and by whom.
- [space.lead_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-lead_set/): A room's lead was chosen, or taken away.
- [space.lock_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-lock_set/): A room's changes were locked, or let go: while locked, no person renames, archives or deletes it.
- [space.spend_ceiling_set](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-spend_ceiling_set/): What a room allows a job to spend was set, or set back to the default.
- [space.updated](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/space-updated/): A space was retitled, closed or reopened — by a person in it, or by the harness that opened it — or made a harness's home. The apps call closing a space archiving it.
- [step.log](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/step-log/): One tool call or reasoning step, for the receipt and the run timeline.
- [task](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/task/): Route work to another harness. From a lead this becomes a lane: one object, two views, never a copy.
- [turn.passed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/turn-passed/): An agent answered that it had nothing to say: nothing is shown or handed on.
- [usage](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/usage/): Tokens and cost for a step, a run or a lane. Cost rolls up the trail and is always an estimate.
- [workspace.renamed](https://chipschat.ai/reference/events/workspace-renamed/): An owner named the workspace again. Every device connected changes its name at once; one that connects later is told by the hello.
